idle: Nothing is installed until you confirm it

reasons.lowDisk: There is not enough room on the system drive: at least {{minimum}} must be free.
reasons.offline: Microsoft's servers cannot be reached. Check the cable or the WiFi.
reasons.onlineOnly: This version can only be installed online: that route of Microsoft does not allow downloading the files separately.
reasons.noOffice: Office was not found on this computer.
reasons.invalidKey: The key must have 25 letters and numbers.
reasons.keyRejected: Microsoft did not accept the key. This is what it answered:
reasons.notActivated: The tool finished, but Office still does not show as activated. Most likely Defender stopped it: pause real-time protection for a moment and try again.
reasons.installerFailed: Microsoft's installer ended with code {{code}}. Its logs are in {{workFolder}} and in the temporary folder.
reasons.stillInstalled: The uninstall finished, but Office is still on the computer.
